scope: Build Server.Tests only, then execute the complete four-case KeyedSemaphoreTests class with mandatory released Release/package/analyzer flags and zero skips
reasoning: The old firstReleased flag was set after Dispose released the semaphore, so the second lease could legitimately acquire before the flag changed. The second AcquireAsync now executes directly up to its pending semaphore await while the first lease is held. Its incomplete task proves exclusion, acquisition after release proves progress, Count==1 while the second lease is held proves retained entry ownership, and Count==0 after its disposal proves cleanup. No scheduling delay, post-release flag, assertion relaxation, production change or retry is used.
proof_assertions: second acquisition remains incomplete while first lease held
entry count remains1 with a pending waiter
second acquisition completes after first lease release
entry count remains1 while second lease held
entry count returns0 after final disposal
